overview.description: The Roundhill MSTR WeeklyPay ETF (MSTW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of MicroStrategy Incorporated stock (MSTR). MSTW was launched on Jul 24, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
